Name: Junimo Companion Trinket
Author: DcZoidberg
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
This mod adds a new trinket called Special Raisins. When equipped, it summons a cheerful Junimo that hops along beside you as your companion and helps you out while you play.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download this mod and unzip it.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Put the unzipped folder into your Stardew Valley “Mods” folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]A new trinket, [i]Special Raisins[/i], that summons a Junimo companion.[/*]
[*]Three effects that trigger as you play:
[list]
[*][b]Emergency heal:[/b] when your health drops below 10% of your maximum, a 75% chance the Junimo pulls you back up to half your max health.[/*]
[*][b]Double catch:[/b] a 35% chance that a fish you reel in comes with a second one.[/*]
[*][b]Double harvest:[/b] a 35% chance a harvested crop gives you an extra one, which pops out of the soil and flies to you.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Every trigger shows a floating number, color-coded per effect: green for the heal, blue for fish, gold for crops.[/*]
[*]Drops naturally like any vanilla trinket, from monsters and mine treasure rooms.[/*]
[*]Fully translated into all in-game languages[/*]
[/list]P.S Type this command in the SMAPI terminal to give yourself the special raisin immediately:
[code]give_junimo[/code][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI (required).[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
